summary: Native full game Draw/DrawIndexed GPU-frame sink eligibility now independently validates its own D3D11 BGRA render-target resource size and owner instead of requiring equality with the game desktop backbuffer. The strict D3D9Ex GPU/CPU desktop overwrite, dirty region rollback, original input/gamepad/FFB and stereo mono-safety gates remain unchanged. No observed game, theater visual, Quest3 or OpenXR HMD result.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native real menu/car/race full-frame producer can offer a source texture at its own proven dimensions to an independent-sized XR/theater GPU sink, without using D3D9 desktop backbuffer extent as the sink's geometry proof
Same-device BGRA GPU color render target is validated for real width/height, binding, mip/array/sample count and producer ownership, rejecting missing, stale or mismatched GPU resource

D3D9Ex desktop write still requires exact native-to-desktop size and backbuffer crop/dirty rollback, mono publication permission and complete-source proof; original Draw/Present, gamepad and FFB remain intact
